text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens and meet the criteria specified in the Notice by the Ministry of Education of Regulating Admission of International Students to China's Higher Education Institutions (Letter No.12 [2020] of the Ministry of Education), physically and mentally healthy, friendly to China and have no criminal record. 2. Applicants should possess at minimum a high school diploma or equivalent qualification. 3. Language proficiency requirements: Chinese-taught majors: Applicants must pass the HSK Level 4 examination (240 points or above) . Applicants with the highest level of education taught in Chinese are exempt from providing an HSK certificate, but must provide proof of the language of instruction. Applicants who haven’t reached the required Chinese language level can apply for Preparatory Programs (Chinese Language Program).
